control_name: System interfaces reconcile on control totals
control_objective: Data transmitted across in-scope system interfaces is reconciled on record counts and control totals between the sending and receiving systems, so that no financially-significant records are lost, duplicated, or altered in transit.
risk_addressed: Interface failures, dropped messages, or duplicate processing can cause financially-significant records to be incompletely or inaccurately transferred between systems, misstating the general ledger.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A transmission run for an in-scope interface, including source record counts and control totals.
The record count and control total received and recorded by the general ledger for the corresponding interface run.

method.summary: For each in-scope interface, compare source record counts and control totals to the totals received by the general ledger, confirming zero unreconciled records and zero control-total variance.
steps: Enumerate the in-scope interfaces and their transmission runs for the period.
Pull source-side record counts and control totals from the integration bus.
Pull receiving-side record counts and control totals from the general ledger.
Reconcile each interface run, identifying any unreconciled records or control-total variance.
Document resolution for any exception and confirm tie-out across all in-scope interfaces.
method.fallback_logic: If either the integration bus or the general ledger is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unreconciled record or control-total variance on an in-scope interface is a control exception.
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Any unreconciled record or control-total variance

pass_criteria: No unreconciled records exist across in-scope interfaces.
Interface control totals tie out to zero variance.
fail_criteria: One or more interface records are unreconciled.
exception_handling: Resolve the interface exception and re-reconcile before relying on the control.

assertions.description: No unreconciled records across in-scope interfaces.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each cycle before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify Financial Systems Analyst and Controller
